evidence: The film thickness and uniformity of the Hf-silicate and SiO2 films were measured with an ellipsometer over 300 mm wafers. The composition of Hf-silicate films was measured with high-resolution Rutherford backscattering (HRRBS) analysis with 450 keV helium ion (He+) beam. Residual impurities such as carbon, hydrogen, and nitrogen were analyzed by secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) with a 1 keV cesium primary ion (Cs+) beam.
